shots.note: medium push_in: Below the title card the newborn Rudra stands in a bright gold-orange sky with his fire halo; on 'anger' his eyes blaze red and a warm glow flares behind him.
medium dolly_left: Rudra raises his hand on 'demand' but turns his blazing eyes away from a gold crown that glows faintly beside him: power is not what he wants.
close static: Close on Rudra's face: red eyes, mouth open as he demands; an empty name plate with a question mark appears above him on 'name'.
establishing crane_down: Brahma sits on his pink lotus in his bright blue-gold hall, soft rays fall on him and his name plate appears as he is named.
medium push_in: A ring of light opens around Brahma's head on 'mind' and four small child sages fade in at the foot of his lotus, two on 'four', two on 'sons'.
wide dolly_right: The four boy sages stand in a row on the clouds with folded hands and ash marks, calm and young; their name appears on 'Kumaras'.
medium pull_out: Brahma on his lotus talks with open hands; on 'world' the clouds below him cross-fade to a green valley with a river, the empty world he wants filled.
two_shot push_in: Two Kumaras in front and two behind fold their hands on 'folded'; on 'no' they gently turn their heads aside, polite but firm.
close static: Close on one boy sage: a warm smile and a small bow of the head on 'grateful', a soft gold glow behind him.
two_shot dolly_left: Two Kumaras step back with open hands while a gold wheel, the round of birth and death, turns in the sky above them on 'life'; they look away from it.
wide crane_up: The four Kumaras sit cross-legged with closed eyes in a violet-gold sky; on 'infinite' a glowing infinity sign opens above them.
medium push_in: One Kumara asks with open pleading hands on 'asked', then folds them; a pale ring of light opens behind his young face on 'never', the youth he keeps for ever.
medium tilt_down: Brahma on his lotus points and argues with a frown on 'argued'; on 'gave' his hands open and his eyes drop, giving in.
wide pan_right: The window follows the four Kumaras walking off over the clouds to the right and fading, while Brahma at the left edge watches them go.
close push_in: Close on Brahma's faces: brows crush down and his eyes turn red on 'rage' as the sky behind him floods bright fire-orange and a red pulse throbs.

medium handheld: Brahma on his lotus with angry red eyes; on 'fiery' his forehead glows, then flames and a white-gold column of fire shoot up from it and a small figure with a fire halo rises in the column.
medium push_in: Rudra walks forward out of the column of fire, his fire halo burning behind him; on 'blazing' his eyes flare red.
close handheld: Close on Rudra roaring, mouth wide and eyes red; rings of fire-orange sound burst out from him on 'roared' and the frame shakes.
medium tilt_up: Brahma on his lotus stares up with wide eyes and parted lips, still and amazed, the orange firelight of Rudra falling on him from above.
two_shot pull_out: Stacked: above, Rudra lunges forward with raised hand and red eyes, roaring; below, Brahma looks up at him in fear and wonder.
medium push_in: Brahma on his lotus turns his eyes up and smiles as he remembers; a soft gold ring of light opens behind his heads on 'remembered'.
medium dolly_right: Rudra below with red eyes; the word 'red' appears in red on 'red', 'roaring' on 'roaring' as his mouth opens, and the big gold root 'rud' between them on 'rud'.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Brahma raising his hand in blessing to Rudra, whose red eyes calm as he is named; the name plate 'Rudra' appears over him.
medium crane_up: Rudra's fire halo cools into Shiva's blue halo: on 'Shiva' the newborn dissolves into the familiar Mahadev with trishul and serpent, and his name plate appears on 'Mahadev'.
medium push_in: Brahma smiles on his lotus in gold light, book and mala in his hands; the plate 'Creator' appears.
medium dolly_left: Blue Vishnu stands calm and smiling in his blue-gold sky with a raised blessing hand; the plate 'Preserver' appears.
medium tilt_up: Shiva with his trishul in a violet-rose sky, his face stern; his third eye glows and the plate 'Destroyer' appears.
two_shot pan_right: The window pans from Brahma pleading with open hands to Shiva, who listens calmly with his head tilted.
medium crane_down: Shiva nods with folded hands on 'agreed', then opens his hands on 'making'; a first being of light, his own shape, fades in behind him on 'beings'.
wide pull_out: Around Shiva, four beings with his face, jata and fire halo fade in one after another on 'copies' and 'himself'; on 'immortal' a ring of undying light opens behind them.
two_shot static: Stacked: above, eleven identical Rudras with fire halos stand in three rows on the clouds; below, Brahma on his lotus looks at them in surprise.
medium tilt_down: Brahma explains from his lotus, eyes on the sky; above him the gold wheel of birth and death turns on 'die' and glows on 'born': what creation needs.
medium dolly_right: Shiva speaks calmly with an open hand while two of his fire-haloed copies stand faint behind him.
medium push_in: Shiva closes his eyes and folds his hands on 'meditate' as the hall behind him cross-fades to the white Himalaya.
wide pan_right: On a bright snowy slope Shiva walks away to the right with his trishul and fades into the white haze.

wide pull_out: Shiva sits in meditation on the snowy peak with closed eyes; behind him a faint warm glow of the fire he was born from, and on 'never' a ring of undying light opens as the camera pulls away.
